purpose: Three palette + type candidates to apply to trybounce.ai for live A/B comparison. Apply one candidate at a time.

fonts.shared_html_snippet: <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Onest:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Sofia+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

display.use_for: Wordmark, headlines, section titles, button labels

body.use_for: Body copy, paragraphs, meta text, form labels

wordmark_rule.name: Colored-U rule
wordmark_rule.description: In the 'bounce' wordmark, and in titles/headlines that contain a lowercase 'u', the 'u' character is rendered in the primary color. Body copy is not affected. The rule applies to display type only — never to running paragraphs.

color_role_glossary.background: Page background. The canvas the brand sits on.
color_role_glossary.text: Default body and heading text color.
color_role_glossary.primary: The brand accent. The colored 'u', primary CTAs, key accents, hover states, anything brand-led.
color_role_glossary.secondary: Grounding / authority color. Secondary CTAs, links, contrast badges, feature numbers, supporting accents.
color_role_glossary.muted: Quiet third tone. Cards, alternate row backgrounds, dividers, disabled states, watermark-style accents.

candidates.name: Marigold · Refined
candidates.summary: Marigold's amber + navy palette with Onest for display and Sofia Sans for body. Premium without seriousness; conversational without going soft.

candidates.name: Greenhouse + Clementine · Light
candidates.tag: Green primary, orange secondary, lighter ground
candidates.summary: Greenhouse's green leads, Clementine's orange replaces sienna as the secondary. Background pulled halfway toward white for a brighter, more app-like ground.

candidates.name: Greenhouse + Marigold
candidates.summary: Green leads, Marigold's amber as the secondary. More golden than orange, more value-coded than fresh.

implementation_notes: Load the shared Google Fonts URL once at the top of <head> (preconnect lines included for fastest first paint).
Apply colors via the css_variables block — easy to swap candidates by replacing one root block.
If using Tailwind, paste tailwind_extend_colors into theme.extend.colors. Refer to colors as bg-bounce-primary, text-bounce-text, etc.
Map font roles: body and form copy use Sofia Sans (--bounce-font-body); headlines, the wordmark, and CTA labels use Onest (--bounce-font-display).
Apply the colored-U rule to the wordmark and to display headlines — see wordmark_rule.html_pattern. Do not apply to body copy.
All three candidates share the same fonts — only the colors change between them, so swapping is a one-block edit.
